get.description: Proxies PokéSearch's search with q (the search text), page (from 1; PokéSearch clamps it to its last reachable page) and page_size (PokéSearch's default is 24) only; any other query parameter answers 422. Pagination passes through unchanged: pages is PokéSearch's count, which stops at its 9,600-result window, so read pages rather than computing it from total.
get.summary: Search cards in the PokéSearch catalog

get.description: The card comes from the PokéSearch catalog; variants lists the PokéPrices variants of the card with their current TCGplayer mappings, and catalog names the PokéSearch dataset that answered. Each variant carries price: its newest daily close from TCGplayer market prices via TCGCSV, one close per day, with source, feed and as_of on each variant (as_of is the snapshot marker of the close's day), the previous close of the same series epoch within 14 days and the change since it; price is null when the collected snapshots hold no close for the variant. An id outside the PokéSearch card id pattern, or one PokéSearch does not have, answers 404 card-not-found; catalog_missing is true when PokéPrices holds variant rows for an id PokéSearch no longer has (the rows are flagged, never deleted). While PokéSearch is unavailable the last good copy answers with meta.degraded true and meta.stale_since, or 503 when there is none.
get.summary: Read one card, hydrated with its PokéPrices variants

get.description: as_of is the snapshot marker of the newest successfully ingested TCGCSV day (TCGplayer market prices, one close per day) and day is its date; age_hours is the time from as_of to measured_at in hours with one decimal, rounded half up. within_slo is judged on the unrounded age: true while it is under slo_hours (26), so 25.96 hours is within the SLO even though it shows 26.0. measured_at is the server clock and the only clock value in the answer. With no successful ingest, as_of, day and age_hours are null and within_slo is false. last_run is the newest ingest run of any status (null when none ran). A breached SLO is a normal 200 answer: it means no newer day was ingested in time. The answer is never cached.
get.summary: How old the newest collected PokéPrices prices are, against the 26 hour freshness SLO

get.description: One series per PokéPrices variant of the card, ordered by variant_key, each with its daily points ascending by day: TCGplayer market prices via TCGCSV, one close per day. range is 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD or 1Y (default 1M); the window ends on to, the newest ingested day, and starts on from (to minus 6, 29, 89 or 364 days, or January 1 of to's year for YTD), so it follows the data, never the clock. Days without a row are gaps. A filled point (is_filled true) repeats the close of filled_from for at most 14 days; every point's as_of is the snapshot marker of the close it shows, and meta.as_of is the marker of the newest ingested day. series_epoch changes when the variant's TCGplayer mapping starts a new series; never compare closes across it. history_begins is the day of the variant's first collected close in any series epoch, or null when PokéPrices holds none; it does not depend on range. With nothing ingested yet, from, to and as_of are null and every series is empty. The prices come from PokéPrices alone: a valid id PokéPrices holds no variants for answers 200 with data: [], which does not mean the card is unknown (GET /v1/cards/{id} says whether a card exists). An id outside the card id pattern answers 404 card-not-found.
get.summary: Read the daily closes of a card's variants over a chart range

get.description: The variants whose TCGplayer market close (via TCGCSV, one close per day) moved most against their previous close, from the ranked snapshot PokéPrices builds when it ingests a day: meta.day is the newest day with movers and meta.as_of its snapshot marker. A variant counts when it has a real close on that day and a previous close of at least meta.min_previous_close (2.00 USD) in the same series epoch within 14 days; direction up lists rises and down lists falls (default up), ranked by the absolute change in percent, then the absolute change, then variant_key; limit is 1 to 50 (default 20). The window is the previous close, which may be more than one day back when a day had no close. Each row names its card from the PokéSearch catalog (card is null when PokéSearch does not have the id); while PokéSearch is unavailable, names come from the last good copy or are null, and meta.degraded is true. With no movers yet, data is [] and meta.day and meta.as_of are null.
get.summary: Read the biggest movers of the newest collected day
